item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit from e92333ed: aaaa9bc2f changes the SVG height formula and legend column count plus a measured legend_rows receipt, 3fac2cde4 adds the three-canvas aspect test and the four/six-trace legend test with a regex size helper, and e5d4baed0 adds only the 42-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The measure (prompt.txt:116) asks for three canvases within one part in a thousand, the default slide size, four- and six-trace legend rows, and a width-pinned negative control; tests/plotting/test_signals.py:167 and :186 implement exactly those assertions, logs/gate-tests-plotting.log closes with "26 passed, 1 warning in 5.63s" and a bare EXIT=0, and logs/negative-control-width-pin.log fails the wide and narrow arms with "1.9451388888888888 <= (3.888888888888889 / 1000)" and "0.7772222222222224 <= (0.7777777777777778 / 1000)" while the default arm passes.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal (prompt.txt:38) is that the shared save function exports any canvas without distortion and the signal plot's legend sits on one row; imas_codex/plotting/style.py:72 now derives the SVG height as SLIDE_WIDTH_CM * figheight / figwidth and imas_codex/plotting/signals.py:217-218 sizes the legend to min(lines, 6) columns, both matching the goal, with the envelope-mode caveat at signals.py:218, and the default canvas still declares 31.1cm x 16cm.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; manifest.md:7 names commits aaaa9bc2f, 3fac2cde4 and e5d4baed0, :12 names the plotting-suite command, :13 and :14 name the gate and negative-control logs, and :6 claims the gate green at the head although the gate log's revision header reads 3fac2cde4.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source dispatch's FENCE — SCOPE (prompt.txt:85-87) grants only docs/evidence/fragments/figure-scripts-use-the-shared-save-function/save-function-keeps-aspect.html and the docs/figures node directory, yet git diff --stat e92333ed e5d4baed0 also changes imas_codex/plotting/style.py, imas_codex/plotting/signals.py and tests/plotting/test_signals.py.

justifications.durability: tests/plotting/test_signals.py:182 fails if the height formula reverts to the pinned 16cm derivation (the negative-control log shows exactly that failure), but the legend guard at :190 asserts a row count that the production block at imas_codex/plotting/signals.py:233 computes from the legend under test, so a measurement that always reported one row would leave it green, and the envelope path is untested.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-tests-plotting.log closes with "26 passed, 1 warning in 5.63s" and a bare EXIT=0 at revision 3fac2cde4, and logs/negative-control-width-pin.log shows the two non-default aspect arms FAILED under the restored pre-fix formula with EXIT=1, matching every clause of the done_when, though neither arm names a baseline revision.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/plotting/style.py:12 names the slide width as SLIDE_WIDTH_CM beside the existing CANVAS constant and imas_codex/plotting/signals.py:244 adds the receipt key in the same dict as time_base and summaries, though legend_rows is assigned twice at :224 and :233.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/plotting/style.py:72 derives the declared height from the figure's own width-to-height ratio under the fixed slide width, so every canvas exports at its drawn ratio, and imas_codex/plotting/signals.py:237 keeps the single checked export path.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing owner at imas_codex/plotting/style.py:42 save_figure rather than forking it, but the envelope legend layout at imas_codex/plotting/signals.py:218 keeps a fixed six-column cap instead of extending the same measurement it uses for the receipt.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat e92333ed e5d4baed0 lists four paths, three of which lie outside the two paths FENCE — SCOPE granted at prompt.txt:86-87.
